meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 迁移旧版 NanoClaw 和 Claude 原生内存文件到统一共享内存树，整理成带索引的分类结构并更新常驻指令，最后给出迁移报告供确认。不会擅自删除或覆盖已有文件。
howto.when: 当系统更新后提示共享内存不兼容，或发现旧版 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等遗留文件；也可在你说“migrate memory”等触发词时启动。

say.text: 请把旧版 CLAUDE.md 迁移到共享记忆里。
say.note: Claude 会按流程整理并给出报告。

say.text: 更新后 agent 失忆了，请迁移记忆。
检查并迁移这个项目的遗留记忆文件。
say.note: 会扫描已有的 .seed.md 等文件。

howto.what_en: Claude migrates old NanoClaw/Claude memory files into the shared memory tree, sorts them into indexed files, updates standing instructions, and produces a migration report for approval. Existing files are never overwritten.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an update reports incompatible shared memory, when legacy files like .seed.md or CLAUDE.md are found, or when you say 'migrate memory'.

say_en.text: Migrate my legacy CLAUDE.md into the shared memory.
say_en.note: Claude will run the migration flow and report back.

say_en.text: The agent forgot everything after the switch—please migrate memory.
Check and migrate legacy memory files for this project.
